name: Kaikawa Chisato
source: A magical warrior from a different world. Her comrades - [url=/c47587]Serena[/url], [url=/c47588]Sincere[/url] and [url=/c47592]Queen Justice[/url] - were sealed away by a demon Dirac. To save them, she pursues Dirac to another world, where she encounters Rena.
